**Finding: deviation (GOVLAW)**

Section 28.1 imposes Singapore law and exclusive Singapore jurisdiction — outside the accepted list and in walk-away territory (exclusive foreign venue), and it flatly conflicts with Section 28.2's exclusive New York County forum. I proposed a minimal redline replacing only the choice-of-law and forum words in 28.1 with New York law and the state and federal courts in New York County, matching the preferred position and reconciling the internal conflict; the 28.3 escalation process is acceptable and untouched.
